contact_uv_repair.authored_assumption: Companion hidden rear-contact surfaces use the measured dominant-channel source palette. Dark neutral fringe within one ring of the part interface is authored as that palette; body dominant-color fringe is mapped to adjacent ivory/charcoal material. Blender -Y is authored front and +Y back; front half/front-facing surfaces and light details are protected. This is explicit local unseen-surface authoring, not inferred ground truth.
contact_uv_repair.protection: Detached-part front half, front-facing surfaces, light details and dominant-color surfaces are not recolored
contact_uv_repair.space: Calibrated Blender +Z up/-Y front/+Y back; not automatic hidden-texture recovery
